text: Full disclosure is one researcher, one flaw, published to everyone, usually after the vendor stops answering. This is every weapon we hold, handed out at once.
style: Cinematic thriller. Consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, deliberate, unhurried. SAFETYNET's director, running a raid from a folding table in the Montana cold; he does not raise his voice and he does not soften anything, and under the control this one is personal.
